newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota denies it plans to double stake in Hino.
newsitem.headline: Toyota denies it plans to double stake in Hino.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp on Friday denied media reports that it plans to double its stake in Japanese truck maker Hino Motors Ltd.
The reports said Toyota would boost its shareholding in Hino to more than 20 percent from the current 11.08 percent, in a move to increase its control over Hino's management.
"We have no such plan," a company spokeswoman said.
Toyota and Hino, Japan's largest truck manufacturer, have had business ties since 1966.
Hino produces Toyota's HiLux Surf sport-utility vehicle and HiLux pickup trucks at its Hamura plant in suburban Tokyo. It also produces its own brand of heavy and light trucks.
